en: \bThis leads to the White Ruins. Only Cheren can say who goes here.
it: \bDi qui si va alle Rovine Bianche. Solo Komor può decidere chi entra.

id: \bEveryone is helping out to get the gym ready.
en: \bEveryone is helping out to get the gym ready.
it: \bTutti stanno dando una mano per preparare la Palestra.

id: \rAlexa: Ah, hello there. Are you one of the natives?
en: \rAlexa: Ah, hello there. Are you one of the natives?
it: \rAlexa: Ah, salve. Sei di queste parti?

id: \rOh, you're from Kanto. I've heard of it before. I would love to visit, but I have to get back to Kalos and submit my report.
en: \rOh, you're from Kanto. I've heard of it before. I would love to visit, but I have to get back to Kalos and submit my report.
it: \rOh, vieni da Kanto. Ne ho sentito parlare. Mi piacerebbe visitarla, ma devo tornare a Kalos e consegnare il mio reportage.

id: \rI take it you've never been to Kalos before. It's a facinating place with lots to do and see. My sister is a gym leader there.
en: \rI take it you've never been to Kalos before. It's a facinating place with lots to do and see. My sister is a gym leader there.
it: \rImmagino che tu non sia mai stato a Kalos. È un posto affascinante, con un sacco di cose da fare e da vedere. Mia sorella è Capopalestra lì.

id: \rYou seem interested in gyms. You should come visit.
en: \rYou seem interested in gyms. You should come visit.
it: \rSembri interessato alle Palestre. Dovresti venire a trovarci.

id: \rI'm going to head home now. I would suggest you do the same.
en: \rI'm going to head home now. I would suggest you do the same.
it: \rIo ora torno a casa. Ti consiglierei di fare lo stesso.

id: \rAlexa: I'm going to head home now. I would suggest you do the same.
en: \rAlexa: I'm going to head home now. I would suggest you do the same.
it: \rAlexa: Io ora torno a casa. Ti consiglierei di fare lo stesso.

id: \bThe White Ruins is near here. Only powerful Trainers are allowed to enter.
en: \bThe White Ruins is near here. Only powerful Trainers are allowed to enter.
it: \bLe Rovine Bianche sono qui vicino. Solo gli Allenatori forti possono entrare.

id: \rKrabby
en: \rKrabby
it: \rKrabby

id: \bYou look strong. Maybe you can go battle Cheren for me. He needs some practice.
en: \bYou look strong. Maybe you can go battle Cheren for me. He needs some practice.
it: \bSembri forte. Magari puoi andare a sfidare Komor al posto mio. Ha bisogno di fare pratica.

id: \rWant to learn Secret Sword?
en: \rWant to learn Secret Sword?
it: \rVuoi imparare Spadamistica?

id: \rCome back anytime!
en: \rCome back anytime!
it: \rTorna quando vuoi!

id: \bI heard Cheren said you could enter. Good luck.
en: \bI heard Cheren said you could enter. Good luck.
it: \bHo sentito che Komor ti ha dato il permesso di entrare. Buona fortuna.

id: \rAh, there you are! My husband was looking for you.
en: \rAh, there you are! My husband was looking for you.
it: \rAh, eccoti! Mio marito ti stava cercando.

id: \rI'm the Day-Care Lady. We can raise Pokémon for you.
en: \rI'm the Day-Care Lady. We can raise Pokémon for you.
it: \rSono la Signora della Pensione. Possiamo allevare i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rWould you like us to raise your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like us to raise your Pokémon?
it: \rVuoi che alleviamo un tuo Pokémon?

id: \rOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.
en: \rOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.
it: \rOh? Ma hai un solo Pokémon con te.

id: \rYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.
en: \rYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.
it: \rNon puoi andartene senza un Pokémon. Torna un'altra volta.

id: \rWhich Pokémon should we raise for you?
en: \rWhich Pokémon should we raise for you?
it: \rQuale Pokémon dobbiamo allevare?

id: \rOh, fine, then.\nCome again.
en: \rOh, fine, then.\nCome again.
it: \rOh, va bene, allora.\nTorna presto.

id: \rIf you leave me that Pokémon, what are you gonna battle with?
en: \rIf you leave me that Pokémon, what are you gonna battle with?
it: \rSe mi lasci quel Pokémon, con cosa lotterai?

id: \rCome back another time.
en: \rCome back another time.
it: \rTorna un'altra volta.

id: \rFine, we'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
en: \rFine, we'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
it: \rBene, alleveremo il tuo \v[3] per un po'.

id: \rCome back for it later.
en: \rCome back for it later.
it: \rTorna a prenderlo più tardi.

id: \rWe can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like us to raise another?
en: \rWe can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like us to raise another?
it: \rPossiamo allevare due dei tuoi Pokémon. Vuoi che ne alleviamo un altro?

id: \rVery good. Come again.
en: \rVery good. Come again.
it: \rMolto bene. Torna a trovarmi.

id: \rAh, it's you! Good to see you. Now, about your Pokémon...
en: \rAh, it's you! Good to see you. Now, about your Pokémon...
it: \rAh, sei tu! Che piacere vederti. Allora, riguardo ai tuoi Pokémon...

id: \rBy level, your \v[3] has grown by about \v[4].
en: \rBy level, your \v[3] has grown by about \v[4].
it: \rIl tuo \v[3] è salito di circa \v[4] livelli.

id: \rDo you want your Pokémon back?
en: \rDo you want your Pokémon back?
it: \rVuoi riprenderti il tuo Pokémon?

id: \rYour Pokémon team is full. Make room, then come see me.
en: \rYour Pokémon team is full. Make room, then come see me.
it: \rLa tua squadra è al completo. Fai spazio e poi torna da me.

id: Which one do you want back?
en: Which one do you want back?
it: Quale vuoi riprenderti?

id: \G\rIf you want your \v[3] back, it will cost $\v[4].
en: \G\rIf you want your \v[3] back, it will cost $\v[4].
it: \G\rSe rivuoi il tuo \v[3], ti costerà $\v[4].

id: \G\rYou don't have enough money...
en: \G\rYou don't have enough money...
it: \G\rNon hai abbastanza soldi...

id: \G\rExcellent\nHere's your Pokémon.
en: \G\rExcellent\nHere's your Pokémon.
it: \G\rPerfetto!\nEcco il tuo Pokémon.

id: \PN took \v[3] back from the Day-Care Lady.
en: \PN took \v[3] back from the Day-Care Lady.
it: \PN ha ripreso \v[3] dalla Signora della Pensione.

id: \rDo you want to take back the other one, too?
en: \rDo you want to take back the other one, too?
it: \rVuoi riprenderti anche l'altro?

id: \bWe are finally getting a gym leader! The tourists are going to be coming any day now.
en: \bWe are finally getting a gym leader! The tourists are going to be coming any day now.
it: \bFinalmente avremo un Capopalestra! I turisti arriveranno da un giorno all'altro.

id: \bAh, it's you!
en: \bAh, it's you!
it: \bAh, sei tu!

id: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
en: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
it: \bStavamo allevando il tuo Pokémon e, santo cielo, che sorpresa!

id: \bYour Pokémon was holding an Egg!
en: \bYour Pokémon was holding an Egg!
it: \bIl tuo Pokémon aveva con sé un Uovo!

id: \bWe don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
en: \bWe don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
it: \bNon sappiamo come ci sia finito, ma ce l'aveva il tuo Pokémon.

id: \bYou do want it, don't you?
en: \bYou do want it, don't you?
it: \bLo vuoi, vero?

id: \bYou have no room for it right now... Come back when you've made room.
en: \bYou have no room for it right now... Come back when you've made room.
it: \bAl momento non hai spazio... Torna quando ne avrai fatto.

id: \me[Egg get]\PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
en: \me[Egg get]\PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
it: \me[Egg get]\PN ha ricevuto l'Uovo dal signore della Pensione.

id: \bYou take good care of it.
en: \bYou take good care of it.
it: \bAbbine cura, mi raccomando.

id: \bI really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
en: \bI really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
it: \bAllora lo tengo davvero. Lo vuoi questo Uovo, sì?

id: \bWell all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
en: \bWell all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
it: \bVa bene, allora lo prendo io. Grazie.

id: \bThat is, I don't think we'll ever find another...
en: \bThat is, I don't think we'll ever find another...
it: \bCioè, non credo che ne troveremo mai un altro...

id: \bNo, no, I'm sure we'll find another one. I'm definitely sure of it!
en: \bNo, no, I'm sure we'll find another one. I'm definitely sure of it!
it: \bNo, no, sono sicuro che ne troveremo un altro. Ne sono assolutamente certo!

id: \bI'm the Day-Care Man.
en: \bI'm the Day-Care Man.
it: \bSono il Signore della Pensione.

id: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of trainers.
en: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of trainers.

id: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
en: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
it: \bSe vuoi far allevare un Pokémon, puoi lasciarlo alle cure di mia moglie.

id: \bAh, it's you!\nGood to see you!
en: \bAh, it's you!\nGood to see you!
it: \bAh, sei tu!\nChe piacere vederti!

id: \bYour \v[3] is doing just fine.
